proposed_causal_matching_rule.satellite_availability_time: Acquisition_End_Time (UTC; attrs have no offset, treated as GMT/UTC per MOSDAC Acquisition_Time_in_GMT)
proposed_causal_matching_rule.rationale: On all parseable files, /time equals catalog/filename slot and is at or immediately after Acquisition_Start_Time, while Acquisition_End_Time is ~27 minutes later. Using /time or start as 'available at T' would leak pixels still being acquired. A prediction at T may use a scan only if acquisition_end <= T.
proposed_causal_matching_rule.raw_scan_timestamp_retained: /time decoded UTC, stored separately as sat_observation_time_utc; not the availability clock
proposed_causal_matching_rule.maximum_age_basis: Observed acquisition duration median 26.9 min; /time is ~0.45 min before start. Age is T - acquisition_end. 90 minutes is a causal recency cap (~3 native 30-min slots), not a fit to MVP thinned gaps (median 180 min). Sparse windows will often be NOT_OBSERVED under this cap.
proposed_causal_matching_rule.no_valid_recent_scan: sat_observation_available=0; all other satellite fields null. Do not copy an older scan. Do not fill 0.
proposed_causal_matching_rule.multiple_completed_scans: Among scans with acquisition_end <= T and (T - acquisition_end) <= 90 min, keep the one with the latest acquisition_end (most recently completed). Tie: smaller gId. Do not average.
proposed_causal_matching_rule.hourly_row_T: Atmospheric/NWP timestamp T is the start of [T, T+1h). Features at T must not use scans that finish after T.
proposed_causal_matching_rule.gId_7680747: MISSING_DOWNLOAD; treated as no scan; do not retry
proposed_causal_matching_rule.feature_contract_10i1: NOT modified in this audit. 10I.1 join used /time in [T, T+1h), which is not causal. Correction belongs in a later contract revision.
